title: Petra — Al-Khazneh (3D Gaussian splatting, walkable)
description: Photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting of the Treasury façade (Al-Khazneh) in Petra, Jordan — the Nabataean rock city (UNESCO World Heritage). Trained from 221 drone images (COLMAP → gsplat, 498k Gaussians). Source: CULTURE3D (Zheng et al., ICCV 2025), research/demo use with attribution.

splat.note: Trainiertes 3DGS (498k, sauber) - Petra-Fassade (Al-Khazneh), extern gehostet (Hugging Face).
